note: Built 21 November 2026. DEFINITION: anywhere a visitor goes to hear live jazz with a drink and a seat - jazz clubs, cocktail bars and pubs with a regular jazz programme, and restaurants where the band is the reason to go. Readers search 'jazz bars london', 'jazz clubs london', 'live jazz london'. Overlaps with best-live-music-venues-london (its Jazz section), dinner-and-a-show-london and best-speakeasy-bars-london (Nightjar); the pages link both ways. Only sources dated 2023 or later are counted.

awardBodies.name: Parliamentary Jazz Awards
awardBodies.note: Jazz Venue of the Year. UK-wide; winners 2023 Jazz at the Blue Lamp (Aberdeen), 2024 The Verdict (Brighton), 2025 Digbeth Jazz, 2026 SoundCellar (Poole). London nominees: Cafe Oto and 91 Living Room (2024), 606 (2025), World Heart Beat and Church of Sound (2026 shortlist).

knownGaps: Reddit could not be read from the research environment; the two r/Jazz threads (Nov and Dec 2025) were carried over from the dinner-and-a-show corpus.
YouTube: only one channel (Three Man Abroad). A search for London jazz-bar videos was not run through Apify, to keep the pass free.
Country and Town House's jazz list could not be read.
DesignMyNight's page was only partly read; Vortex, Ottie's Salon, The Bootlegger and Bloomsbury Club Bar appear in its unread part and were not recorded from it.
London Jazz News (Sebastian Scotney) publishes no single venue guide; its venue coverage is through ShortList.
openVenueQuestions: Brasserie Zédel (Reddit) vs The Crazy Coqs: left apart.
Hidden Jazz Bar at The Vaults (London x London) vs Hidden Jazz Club, the roving series (The Nudge, DesignMyNight): left apart; only the first recorded.
Boisdale: every jazz source names the Canary Wharf branch; recorded as Boisdale of Canary Wharf.
The Blues Kitchen: sources name Camden and Shoreditch branches; recorded as one venue, The Blues Kitchen, as in dinner-and-a-show.
